name: cumulative settlement
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 重复列车作用下逐步积累的沉降。

complete_examples.text: The results show that cumulative settlement is most sensitive to soil strength, followed by train axle loads.
Thus, the prediction of cumulative settlement and assessment of the sub grade status is important to ensure the safety of high-speed trains.
